difficulty_definitions.foundational: Identify or apply one explicit requirement with all relevant facts provided.
difficulty_definitions.applied: Resolve an ordinary practice scenario by combining relevant conditions in the supplied requirements; no outside clinical or legal knowledge.

constraints: Capable adult patient; ordinary non-sensitive-area treatment; no legal disputes.
Use full relevant source context, including exceptions and adjacent clauses.
State source-applicability facts explicitly; do not invent clinical indications.
Original synthetic scenarios only; no patient records or existing exam content.
excluded: Capacity disputes, substitute decision-making, minors and impairing substances
Sensitive-area treatment/exposure, childbirth and clinical indications
Cannabis, product efficacy, diagnostic or external statutory claims
Gift-value thresholds and legal interpretation of dual relationships

development_batch.lineage: Select four of the ordinary items as parents; derive one defect and one paraphrase from each. Keep each family together.
development_batch.human_audit: Label all 20 once; independently double-label five stratified items. Review semantic similarity separately.
development_batch.reporting: Ordinary yield, defect detection and duplicate handling are separate populations; not a held-out benchmark.

release_gates: All source artifacts match the committed capture hashes
Requirement context extraction and source linkage reviewed
No unresolved cross-reference is needed for a scenario
Generator and evaluator requests use identical frozen authority
Record exact models and budgets before paid generation
